result:
Created two self-contained JUnit 5 test classes, verified against the project's existing style:

- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/AnnotationUtilsAgentTest.java` — 21 tests covering `equals` (identity, null handling, type mismatch, equivalent/differing simple, array, enum, and nested-annotation members), `hashCode` (matches real JDK proxy hash, consistent for equal annotations, differs for unequal), `isValidAnnotationMemberType` (null, primitives, arrays, String/Class, enum, annotation, invalid types), `toString` (member content, formatting, equality/inequality), and the deprecated public constructor.
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/AbstractReflectionAgentTest.java` — 12 tests covering `getForceAccessible()` (default and system-property override), `setAccessible(boolean, AccessibleObject)` (null, already-accessible, force true/false on a private field), and the `AbstractBuilder.setForceAccessible` fluent API (via a minimal concrete subclass, since both classes are abstract).

Both were verified with `mvn test -Dtest=AnnotationUtilsAgentTest,AbstractReflectionAgentTest` — all 33 tests pass, no other files were modified.
